title: Pure Springans
summary: Pure Springans with Great Sand Sea - Gold Golgonda, Gigantic "Champion" Sargas, and the 2026 support wave. Every main-deck Springans monster attaches itself from the hand, field, or GY as Xyz Material to a Springans Xyz Monster that Gold Golgonda summons straight from the Extra Deck.

summary.title: Starters
points: Great Sand Sea - Gold Golgonda boosts all Springans Xyz Monsters by 1000 ATK and discards 1 Springans monster to Special Summon a Springans Xyz Monster directly from your Extra Deck while you control no Springans Xyz.
Springans Watch adds Gold Golgonda from your Deck, or if Golgonda is already active, adds 1 Springans monster to your hand and sends another from your Deck to the GY.
Tally-ho! Springans detaches up to 3 materials from your Xyz Monsters to search a Springans monster and Special Summon up to that many Springans from your hand or GY.
Tri-Brigade Springans Kitt (2026 support) Special Summons itself while you control a Springans and revives a Springans when sent to the GY.

summary.title: Opening: Gold Golgonda + Springans Branga
steps: Activate Great Sand Sea - Gold Golgonda and discard Springans Branga to Special Summon Gung-Ho! Springans! (or Springans Merrymaker) from the Extra Deck.
Banish Branga and another Springans from the GY to search Tally-ho! Springans, then activate Tally-ho! detaching from your Xyz to search Springans Rockey and swarm the board.

Rank up a Springans Xyz into Gigantic "Champion" Sargas, which searches a Springans or Therion card (such as Springans Interluder or Springans Blast!), and attach Springans Captain Sargas from the GY as material.

summary.title: Self-Attaching GY Engine
summary.text: Springans Branga, Captain Sargas, Rockey, Brothers, and Pedor can all attach themselves from the hand, field, or GY to any Springans Xyz you control. Discarding Springans Brothers with Golgonda revives a Springans immediately, while Rockey recovers a Springans monster or Gold Golgonda from the GY on summon.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Gigantic "Champion" Sargas stacks on top of any Springans Xyz Monster, searches a Springans card every turn, and destroys or bounces a card on the field whenever any Xyz Material is detached.
Gung-Ho! Springans! (2026 Rank 4) Special Summons Springans Captain Sargas and detaches materials to add or Special Summon a Springans from the Deck.

Springans Captain Sargas detaches 1 material from a face-up Xyz you control during the opponent's turn to destroy a face-up card on the field (triggering Champion Sargas at the same time), and grants 500 ATK while attached.

Springans Merrymaker and Springans Ship - Exblowrer banish themselves until the End Phase during the opponent's turn to dodge removal, with Exblowrer also detaching materials to blow up cards in adjacent zones.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The Fallen of Albaz, Branded, and Therion lore packages from the page are omitted, along with the original Springans Kitt that searches Branded Spells and Traps.
